context: Two coworkers discuss the morning startup routine and tasks
purpose: Teach: 自社/弊社/実務/早期/起動/表記/務め/パート

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: おはようございます、健司さん。今朝もPCの起動が遅くて参りました。
lines.en: Good morning, Kenji. My PC's startup was slow again this morning, it was tough.
lines.style: Polite female office worker greeting in the morning

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おはよう。うちの会社のPCって本当に古いよね。早く新しいのに替えてほしいよ。
lines.en: Morning. Our company's PCs are really old, aren't they. I wish they'd replace them with new ones soon.
lines.style: Friendly male coworker complaining casually about work equipment

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本当に。早期に対応してほしいですよね。
lines.en: Really. I wish they'd address it early on.
lines.style: Polite female office worker agreeing with mild frustration

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ところで、今日の実務って何から始めるの？
lines.en: By the way, what are you starting with for today's actual work?
lines.style: Casual male coworker shifting topic to daily tasks naturally

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: まず自社製品のマニュアル確認です。表記の揺れがないかチェックしないといけなくて。
lines.en: First, checking our own company's product manuals. I have to check for any notation inconsistencies.
lines.style: Polite female office worker explaining her morning task list

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それ大変そうだね。誰かに手伝ってもらえないの？
lines.en: That sounds rough. Can't you get someone to help?
lines.style: Sympathetic male coworker showing concern for colleague workload

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、パートの田中さんにお願いする予定です。私が責任を務めるので大丈夫です。
lines.en: Yes, I'm planning to ask Tanaka, the part-timer. I'll take the responsibility, so it's fine.
lines.style: Polite female office worker explaining her role with quiet confidence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 頼もしいなあ。そういえば、弊社って取引先には言うけど、社内では言わないよね。
lines.en: Reliable as always. By the way, we say 'our humble company' to clients but never inside the office, huh.
lines.style: Casual male coworker making light observation as friendly banter

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ふふ、確かに。じゃあコーヒー淹れてきますね。
lines.en: Hehe, that's true. Well, I'll go make some coffee.
lines.style: Amused polite female office worker wrapping up the chat warmly

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとう。今日も一日頑張ろうね。
lines.en: Thanks. Let's give it our best again today.
lines.style: Warm encouraging male coworker closing the morning conversation
